title: Poruthathu Pothum
desc: A lawyer locks horns with a police officer who is responsible for his mother's death. Later, he gets imprisoned due to a false accusation and reunites with his estranged father in prison.

title: Maharasan
desc: Selvi falls in love with Vadivelu, a butcher. Realising that Vadivelu has to get his sister married first, Selvi helps him find an ideal life partner for his sister.

title: Vetri Thirumagan
desc: Twins, Arun and Ramu, are separated at birth and grow up in different places. Later, fate makes them cross paths, as they strive to take revenge on the perpetrators who broke their family.

title: Pandi Nattu Thangam
desc: A village chief and his father, who control the village activities besides smuggling sandalwood, create problems for a forest officer, Thangapandian, and a fellow villager, Radha.
